MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Reproduction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Ecology and Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Ornamental Fish culture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Fish feeds and feeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Record keeping in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
